question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

HARMONY
solution:
The correct answer is **'Discord.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word** 'Harmony'** means the agreement of ideas, feelings, or actions or a pleasing combination of different parts.(सामंजस्‍य, तालमेल)

 
 
• ***Example:*** *We must try to live in peace and **harmony** with ourselves and those around us.*
 
 
 
• The marked option **'discord' **means lack of concord or harmony between persons or things.(असहमति, अवज्ञा या विवाद, झगड़ा)
 
• As the meanings of* **'harmony'***** **and* '**discord'***** **are opposite to each other, this shows that they are **antonyms **of each other.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tranquility **means a state of peace and quiet(शांति, प्रशांति, शांत अवस्था).
 
• **Goodwill** means friendly, helpful feelings towards other people.(दूसरों के प्रति सद्‌भाव).
